item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00343","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C03","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 is a concrete and material drafting template for the child. Both are executive orders concerning lands acquired by exchange under Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act; both use parallel recitals covering lands already acquired and lands expected to be acquired later; and both prescribe that existing lands are \"added to and reserved\" as parts of the national forests in which they lie while creating an automatic mechanism for later-acquired lands upon federal acquisition of title. The child generalizes C10's Wisconsin-specific machinery nationwide, adds a suitability determination by Agriculture for future acquisitions, and excludes specified western states. C03 and C06 share related current-versus-future land-acquisition machinery, but neither matches the child's statute, national-forest target, and operative sequence as closely as C10.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"certain lands within the exterior boundaries of national forests have been acquired by the United States through exchange under authority of Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act","parent_excerpt":"The United States has acquired through exchange under the authority of Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act ... certain lands lying within the present boundaries of the Nicolet National Forest and the Chequamegon National Forest","explanation":"The recitals identify the same acquisition authority, exchange mechanism, and location of acquired lands inside existing national-forest boundaries."},{"child_excerpt":"it is contemplated that other lands within the exterior boundaries of national forests will be acquired from time to time by the United States through exchange under authority of the said Title III","parent_excerpt":"it is contemplated that the United States will from time to time hereafter acquire through exchange under the said authority additional lands lying within the present boundaries of the said forests","explanation":"This is a distinctive parallel recital anticipating recurring future acquisitions under the same statutory authority."},{"child_excerpt":"all lands within the exterior boundaries of national forests which have been acquired through exchange ... are hereby added to and reserved as parts of the respective national forests within which they are located","parent_excerpt":"All lands within the present boundaries of the Nicolet and Chequmegon National Forests which have been acquired ... through exchange under the authority of Title III ... are hereby added to and reserved as parts of the respective national forests within which they are situated","explanation":"The operative provision closely tracks C10's language and legal machinery, generalized from two named Wisconsin forests to national forests generally."},{"child_excerpt":"all lands ... hereafter acquired ... shall, upon determination by the Department of Agriculture that such lands are suitable for national-forest purposes and upon acquisition of title thereto by the United States, be added to and reserved as parts of the respective national forests","parent_excerpt":"all such lands hereafter acquired by the United States in the manner and under the authority stated shall likewise be added to and reserved as parts of the said forest immediately upon acquisition of title thereto by the United States","explanation":"Both establish prospective automatic reservation of later-acquired lands upon acquisition of federal title; the child adapts the mechanism by adding an Agriculture suitability determination."}]}
